children: According to Odaily, based on monitoring by on-chain analyst Ember, 7 Siblings (0x5ffc...3c37) spent 20 million USDT to buy 10,925.6 ETH seven hours ago at a price of $1,830. Since ETH fell from $2,400, 7 Siblings has spent 60.877 million USDT to buy 31,484 ETH at an average price of $1,933, currently showing a paper loss of $5.57 million.

title: 7 Siblings Buys Additional 10,925.6 ETH
